searchText: <@402080271563751435> +1 for changing the `prover_pubkey: BLSPubkey` into `validator_index: ValidatorIndex` in the `SignedExecutionProof`. Much easier to know if the validator is currently active. (context: https://frisitano.github.io/slides/presentations/optional-proofs/index.html#5) About prover kurtosis integration: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/1311 Yep I believe <@427491045308235776> updated the specs to ensure that the validator is in the current active set. Exactly. And knowing if a validator is currently active is easy to do with its index (because validators in the beacon state are indexed by... validator index). It's more expensive to do if we only know the pubkey.
